spec.method: E181's identical leave-one-out drop set (survivors re-weighted to stay fully invested), read on the arithmetic mean-month level and on the geometric annualisation of the same monthly returns
spec.arith_def: mean(monthly book return) x 12 x 1e4 (the published object)

honest: the two readings are the same monthly returns under two annualisations; the offset is definitional, not an error, and it does not vanish with more data
a survival verdict that differs between them is a verdict about arithmetic, so the reading is published with its definition
the geometric annualisation is undefined (published as null) when the era's growth multiple is non-positive
descriptive census only: no gate, no prereg, no trial count
